properties.name: MEASURED 2026-09-22, for the first time ever: 85.47% region / 87.17% line / 83.70% function coverage across 124 files — the tests are BROAD, not concentrated, and the figure is a FLOOR because the 73 python instruments are invisible to it
properties.statement:
THE FIRST CODE-COVERAGE MEASUREMENT THIS PROJECT HAS EVER TAKEN. `cargo-llvm-cov` 0.9.1 installed 2026-09-22 on Anthony's word and run over the whole workspace with `--no-fail-fast`. Taken to answer his question — how much of reflow2 is untested — after an outside reader called this "an AI coding project".

    regions    62,522 total,  9,085 uncovered   85.47%
    functions   3,455 total,    563 uncovered   83.70%
    lines      40,954 total,  5,256 uncovered   87.17%
    files measured 124; files under 50%: 11

⭐ THE HEADLINE, AND IT REFUTES THE HARSH READING: THE TESTS ARE BROAD. 2,442 test functions were known; nothing said whether they reached widely or piled onto a few modules. They reach widely — 113 of 124 files are at or above 50%, and the workspace sits at 85%. "Heavily tested by volume" can now be stated as a coverage claim rather than withdrawn as one.

🛑 AND THE FIGURE IS A FLOOR, NOT A CEILING — THE CAVEAT MATTERS MORE THAN THE NUMBER. `cargo llvm-cov` instruments `cargo test` ONLY. This project's 73 python instruments drive the REAL BINARY over stdio and HTTP — smoke_mcp, the degraded-server suite against a genuinely held lock, the shared-sessions HTTP suite, the merge-driver suite on real git branches — and none of that execution is visible here. That is exactly why the transport and process layers read low or zero:

    proxy.rs                 0.00%   316 regions   (exercised by --shared / daemon instruments)
    degraded.rs              0.00%    48 regions   (ci.yml runs a degraded-server suite on a real lock)
    main.rs                 32.67% 1,365 regions   (the binary's own entry paths)
    registry_http.rs        27.66%   235 regions
    mcp_http.rs             40.94%   254 regions
    latent.rs               45.05%   293 regions

Read as untested, those six would be a false alarm of about 2,500 regions. They are measurement blind spots, and any coverage gate built on this instrument must say so or it will demand tests for code that is already covered another way.

THE ONE GENUINE THIN SPOT FOUND, and it is small: `reflow2-mcp/src/tools/ingest_tools.rs` — 90 regions, 11 functions, 0.00%. The ingest LOGIC is well covered in the core crate (`corpus.rs`, `ingest_handshake.rs`); what has no test is the MCP TOOL WRAPPER around it. `graphalg/error.rs` is also 0% at 19 regions, which is error-display code.

⇒ WHAT THIS MEANS FOR THE CRITIQUE, stated plainly because it changes the plan. The testing is real and broad; THE RECORD OF IT IS THE PART THAT IS NOT. 282 of 312 Verifications cannot be re-run and 311 read `passing`, while the code underneath them is at 85%. So the work ahead is bookkeeping — making the design's account of verification as true as the verification already is — and NOT a testing rescue. That is a far cheaper problem than the one feared, and it is the opposite of the conclusion that would have been drawn by fixing the record first.

NOT ESTABLISHED: whether the covered lines are covered MEANINGFULLY. Coverage says a line executed, never that an assertion would have caught its corruption — `dec:idea-does-the-build-prove-each-gate-can-go-red` and mutation testing are the instruments for that question, and neither has been run.
